g.title: Upstream container: reads Redis Streams, validates LoginEvent schema, enforces bounded lateness, deduplicates. Delivers a clean LoginEvent to the pipeline.
Inspects Decision Bundles persisted in PostgreSQL. Reads bundle records directly to review decisions, citations, and enforcement outcomes.
pgvector HNSW index for dense policy retrieval (384-dim, all-MiniLM-L6-v2). Audit store for persisted Decision Bundles.
BM25 sparse index over the policy corpus. Jurisdiction and version filters applied at query time.
GPT-4o LLM inference. Receives structured prompt; returns JSON conforming to PolicyGateOutput schema.
Inspects observation.routing (GateRouting enum). FAST_PATH_ALLOW if risk_score < 0.20; FAST_PATH_BLOCK if risk_score > 0.85; ROUTE_TO_GATE otherwise.

Three-stage hybrid RAG over the policy corpus. dense_search (pgvector HNSW cosine) + sparse_search (ES BM25) → rrf_fuse (Reciprocal Rank Fusion k=60) → rerank (cross-encoder; latency-budget bypass falls back to RRF-only). Filters: jurisdictions applied to both stores; risk_tier to pgvector only. app/retrieval/
Bypasses live LLM invocation. Enforces ALLOW or BLOCK directly from the scorer's routing decision. GateContext preserved in the bundle for retrospective shadow evaluation. No retrieval cost.

Resolves prompt template from YamlPromptRegistry via GateContext.prompt_template_id (immutable — never modified after creation). Renders template with domain-supplied template_vars and retrieved snippets. Invokes OpenAI GPT-4o with structured output schema. Produces PolicyGateOutput (action + citations). app/policy_gate/

Deterministic, rule-based action resolution. Priority: HOLD > BLOCK > CHALLENGE > ALLOW. Schema-validation failure always routes to HOLD. Re-executable against cached PolicyGateOutput for replay — no LLM re-invocation. app/enforcement/

Assembles DecisionBundle from all pipeline intermediates: raw event, ReasonerContext, GateContext, rendered prompt, LLM response, enforcement decision, retrieval_path. Persists to PostgreSQL. Replay re-executes enforcement against the cached bundle state. app/audit/

Computes AtoFeatureVector via sliding-window aggregations over per-user event history (velocity, geo-shift, device novelty, credential failure rate). Reads and writes window state in Redis. app/features/

Sliding-window feature state: per-user hashes and sorted sets. TTL-managed. Scoped to the domain layer — simulates real-time event stream state for the Feature Engine; not shared with the framework layer.

XGBoost classifier: consumes AtoFeatureVector, produces ScorerOutput (risk_score ∈ [0,1], GateRouting decision, top-k SHAP signals). Trained on heuristic labels — triages into confidence bands, not fraud detection. app/scorer/

build_observation(): the only function crossing the domain → framework boundary. Translates (LoginEvent, AtoFeatureVector, ScorerOutput) into (ReasonerContext + GateContext + FastPathRecord). reasoner/account_takeover/assembler.py
